name: figma
description: Figma design-to-code suite built on the OFFICIAL Figma MCP server (https://mcp.figma.com/mcp). Vendors Figma's own eight Agent Skills from openai/skills and wires each one to a purpose-built subagent: figma-context-extractor (absorbs the large get_design_context / get_variable_defs / get_screenshot payloads and writes an exact figma-spec.md), figma-asset-fetcher (downloads real icons and images from the MCP asset endpoint — never generates SVG or substitutes an icon pack), figma-design-system-mapper (resolves Figma variables and components against the project's real tokens and component library), and figma-visual-verifier (renders the built screen in Chrome, diffs computed styles against the spec, and fails the task on any drift). The always-on figma-fidelity rule forbids invented assets, rounded spacing and guessed colours, and figma-verify-parity gates completion on a PASS verdict. Replaces the legacy REST-based f-* flow, which had no rendered reference, no real asset export, and no verification loop.

external_setup.name: figma
external_setup.install_hint: claude mcp add --transport http figma https://mcp.figma.com/mcp — then run /mcp and authorise in the browser. For the local server instead, enable the MCP server in Figma desktop (Preferences) and point the url at http://127.0.0.1:3845/mcp.
external_setup.notes: This is NOT the legacy @figma/mcp REST server. The official server provides get_design_context, get_metadata, get_variable_defs, get_screenshot, get_code_connect_map and a localhost asset endpoint — the rendered reference and real asset exports the legacy REST server never had. A project that keeps the old f-* suite installed must not register both under the name `figma`.

external_setup.name: chrome-devtools
external_setup.install_hint: Auto-installs via npx. Requires Node.js and Google Chrome 144+.
external_setup.notes: Drives figma-verify-parity. Without it the parity gate reports NOT RUN, which is deliberately distinct from PASS — a skipped check must stay visible.
